title: WatchlistMirrorPayload
description: Verbatim daily watchlist message mirrored from Discord by signal-source-discord and consumed by WatchlistMirrorWorkflow. Carries the raw watchlist text for the ET calendar date plus dedupe provenance (source_message_id). No parsing/structuring is performed here — downstream consumers interpret raw_text. Reference: docs/plans/PLAN-watchlist-mirror.html.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. See CopytradeSignalPayload.schema_version. Start at 1; bump on non-backward-compatible field changes.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope key. Required on every Activity payload and workflow input.

strategy_id.description: Strategy scope key within the tenant.

et_date.description: ET calendar date of the watchlist (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-06-03'). The America/New_York wall-clock date the message belongs to — NOT a timestamp. Kept as a plain date to avoid timezone/offset ambiguity at the wire boundary. Named et_date (not date) to avoid shadowing the date type in generated models.

author.description: Discord username that posted the watchlist message.

raw_text.description: The verbatim watchlist message body as read from Discord, unmodified. Length intentionally unconstrained (multi-line watchlists vary widely).

source_message_id.description: Discord message id the watchlist was read from; the dedupe key alongside WorkflowIDReusePolicy.REJECT_DUPLICATE.
